name: kamod-ui
description: Lightweight UI components for Preact and Tailwind: composable primitives you can customize, extend, and ship without a heavy runtime. Open source; source is meant to be read and adapted.
author: Klaus Zahiragic <watzak>

scripts.build:docs: pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/themes build && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/ui build && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/openui build && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/ui-docs build
scripts.test:ci: pnpm test && pnpm test:openui && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/ui build && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/openui build && pnpm test:docs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/themes build && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/ui build && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/openui build && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm format:check && pnpm biome:ci && pnpm lint && pnpm test:ci && pnpm build
scripts.qa:package: pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/ui build && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/openui build && pnpm qa:publint && pnpm qa:attw
scripts.qa:openui: pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/openui test && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/openui build && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/openui publint && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/openui attw
scripts.release:check: pnpm test:ci && pnpm build && pnpm qa:publint && pnpm qa:attw
scripts.release:auth: npm whoami --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org || (echo 'Authenticate with: npm login (or set NODE_AUTH_TOKEN)' >&2; exit 1)
scripts.release:quick: pnpm install && pnpm release:check:package && pnpm release:auth && pnpm release:publish
